nexscope/billing.instruction: Check current pricing before execution. Do not automatically retry a paid call.

nexscope/inputExamples.prompt: Keep the product consistent while the camera slowly orbits and highlights material details.

description: Generate a MiniMax H3 video from 1 to 9 required reference images. The model is fixed by this API, so videoType must not be supplied in the request.

aspectRatio.description: Target video aspect ratio supported by this model. Supported values: adaptive, 9:16, 16:9, 1:1, 4:3, 3:4, 21:9.

imageList.description: Public reference image URLs. Provide 1 to 9 images.

isPro.description: Whether to use the model's professional generation mode when supported. Defaults to false.

prompt.description: Video generation prompt describing motion, subject consistency, camera movement, and the ecommerce scene. Maximum 10000 characters.
prompt.example: Keep the product consistent while the camera slowly orbits and highlights material details.

promptOptimizer.description: Whether Nexscope should optimize the video prompt before generation. Defaults to false.

videoTime.description: Video duration in seconds. Supported values: 5, 10, 15.

name: nexscope_minimax_h3_video_generation
title: MiniMax H3 Video Generation
